newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume up on fresh demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume up on fresh demand.

text.p: Volume jumped on Istanbul's gold exchange on Monday due to fresh demand from the free market after weekend gold jewellery and coin sales.
But prices eased slightly in lira terms.
Traded volume was 922 kg, all in lira terms, after 605 kg on Friday. There was no trade in the afternoon session.
"Trade was made only in lira terms because of the holiday in U.S. markets. There was also not much price movement in other international markets," said one dealer.
"Demand picked up because free market dealers wanted to cover their positions after gold sales at the weekend," he added.
Gold slightly eased to 1,152,250 lira per gram from Friday's 1,152,800 lira despite a weaker lira against the dollar in the domestic currency market.
Gold traded in a narrow range at around $381.0 an ounce in thin European markets.
